title: webhook-runner concurrency groups
description: Central declaration of the concurrency groups hooks may reference. Place this file as concurrency.json at the hooks root (the directory the hook folders live under). A hook opts into a group via hook.json's concurrency_group; at most that group's limit of runs execute at once and the rest queue. Referencing a group not declared here is a load/validation error.

$schema.description: URI of the JSON Schema this file is validated against. Set it to https://sites.pazer.build/webhook-runner/branch/master/concurrency.schema.json (the legacy https://wow-look-at-my.github.io/webhook-runner/concurrency.schema.json is still accepted, but serves frozen 2026-07-15 content).

groups.description: Map of group name to its settings. The group name is what a hook.json references via concurrency_group.

limit.description: Maximum number of runs in this group that may execute at once; the rest queue. Default: 1 (full serialization).

description.description: Human-readable description of what the group protects (e.g. a shared local model server).
